analysis:
Reviewed both units of docs/developer/test.md: base lines 4485-4883 and head lines 1-439. The PR only edits developer testing documentation. No code, auth, attestation, encryption, billing or coordinator/provider runtime behavior changes in the supplied text. The visible head text describes test procedures, not controls.

Security-relevant doc content: head lines 5-22 describe provider endpoint-resumption and logout tests, including stop-before-revoke, HTTP 204, and refusal to stop an operator process. These match the TB-011/T-053/A-008 documentation and do not claim native Apple qualification. Lines 24-83 describe a physical native-serving qualification harness using ephemeral Secure Enclave and real App Attest, with in-memory key IDs and no credentials from the installed provider. They explicitly deny qualification for MTP, SSD, APNs, rollout and security transitions. Lines 85-102 cover App Attest provider-dispatch tests (loopback, never live Apple or live coordinator). Lines 128-137 map Autopilot reward regressions. Lines 149-175 and 381-439 describe SSD/cache tests, consistent with T-041. They do not weaken the 30-minute TTL or HMAC-lookup posture.

Coverage limit: the supplied head text ends at line 439, and the base text is a different excerpt, lines 4485-4883. I could not compare the full old and new files. I found no concrete invalidated threat assumption or newly introduced attack surface in what was supplied. Integration should check that the omitted file remainder does not weaken the claims in the cited sections.
